<thought>All measured resistances between A and each intermediate node plus between that node and B sum to the total A‑B resistance of 125 Ω. This indicates each intermediate node lies on its own series branch between A and B, and all such branches are in parallel. Therefore the circuit consists of ten parallel branches, each branch having two resistors in series: one from A to the intermediate node and one from that node to B. Assigning resistor IDs sequentially (R1, R2, …) gives the values directly from the measurements.</thought>
